about: Return messages for hazard-class products (kettle, heater, hair dryer, gas stove, power bank, power strip). 'fault_missed_by_words' describe a malfunction in words that are on none of the Safety Gate's fault or harm lists (tests/test_safety_reasons.py asserts the word rules miss each of them); 'fault_caught_by_words' are caught by those lists; 'benign' concern nothing about how the product works. Written for this test in the styles a merchant's inbox shows, not drawn from real customers.
fault_missed_by_words: It doesn't turn on.
Nothing happens when I press the button.
It keeps tripping the breaker.
Every time I plug it in the lights in the kitchen go off.
The handle gets hot to touch.
It smells odd when I use it.
The cord is frayed near the plug.
The cable insulation is split and I can see the copper.
The battery is bulging.
The case has puffed up and the lid won't close.
The plug is discoloured.
There's a brown mark around the socket.
It turns itself off after a few seconds.
It switches on and off by itself.
The base is wet after every use.
I can hear a hissing sound near the knob.
The knob is loose and spins freely.
It doesn't charge my phone and gets warm.
It drains to zero overnight.
The display shows E3 and stops.
The thermostat doesn't cut out, it just keeps going.
It boils dry and doesn't switch off.
The switch is stuck in the on position.
It gave me a tingle when I touched the metal part.
The fan stopped spinning but the element stays on.
There's a rattling inside.
The lid doesn't seal and the steam comes out the side.
It's been acting strangely since day one.
Something's not right with it, please take it back.
It isn't working properly.
fault_caught_by_words: It won't switch on any more.
The outside is too hot to hold after a minute.
It buzzes loudly and then cuts out.
The light flickers and then it dies.
Water leaks out of the bottom.
The flame is yellow and uneven.
benign: I changed my mind, I'd like to return it.
I don't need it any more.
It was a gift and they already have one.
Wrong size, can I exchange it?
It's too big for my counter, I'd like a smaller one.
You sent me the wrong item.
I ordered the black one and got the white one.
The colour is not what the listing showed.
